_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Weathered fence post with decay at its base beside a braced replacement post and footing excavation
figures.caption: When a post is decayed at grade, the work is more than swapping visible lumber. Fence loads, soil, adjacent rails, and the footing plan all need a look before the old support comes out.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Exterior-rated gate hinge fastened to a sturdy wood post with a diagonal brace behind it
figures.caption: A post may carry rails, a gate, or both. Reconnect each attachment to sound material and keep the assembly plumb instead of relying on a new post to correct a warped fence section.

figures.alt: Roof runoff moving away from a Florida home's exterior structures through a shallow swale
figures.caption: Water that sits around a wood post accelerates the next failure. Grade and roof runoff are part of a durable fence repair, especially in sandy or low-lying yards.
